page.layout: One bookplate, centred on the page: an engraved coat of arms with a motto scroll, and three printed lines below it. No running text, no margins with text. The dark binding, the paper edges and the pale marks at the right are not printed text.
page.notes: The bookplate has an engraved coat of arms (a shield with a chevron, a crest above, and foliage ornament on both sides) with a motto scroll below it, reading approximately "GAUDIO" [?]. The motto is too small to read with certainty. The page is a photograph of the book's cover or pastedown, so the surrounding leather binding, torn paper, and faint handwriting or stains at the right edge are not transcribed.
